lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits; the central visible column contains three primary large-diameter maxima, followed by a posterior column containing two primary maxima and several smaller satellite clusters.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity (light gray) are visible running perpendicular to the carinae, intersecting with the primary white circular blobs to form a discernible rectilinear grid structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher pixel intensity on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density clustering of small, high-luminance spots is visible on the surface of the pectoral fin, showing a higher spatial frequency than the patterns on the primary lateral flank.
